correctness.rationale: The quotient recurrence is triangular because L^2 has constant coefficient one; choosing the first 14/9/10 permitted output coefficients enumerates all 3^14/3^9/3^10 normalized candidates in the three prescribed classes exactly once. Complete integer convolution and endpoint/symmetry checks leave precisely 2/1/2 candidate quotients. The packaged C++17 checker performs both recursive and base-three-counter exhaustive enumerations and checks the exact five vectors. Coefficients of the formal inverse of L^2 through index 21 have total absolute sum 125, so all intermediate values and products are far below signed-64-bit limits. Restoring sign gives 4/2/4, with no extrapolation beyond these finite domains.

value.rationale: The motivating paper optimizes degree of height-one multiples of Lehmer square, so cardinality and rigidity of the exact optimal solution sets are natural structural follow-up invariants. The complete classification shows three distinct optimizer phenomena—one unrestricted reversal orbit, a unique symmetric solution up to sign, and two inequivalent antisymmetric solutions up to sign—and provides all coefficient witnesses. This is a finite but mathematically motivated complete extremizer census, not an arbitrary numerical slice or a restatement of existence.
